surface_mechanism_description: The positive fixed charges introduced by the PEALD-AlN are suggested to be polarization charges in the monocrystalline PEALD-AlN. They can effectively compensate the high-density slow-response acceptor-like interface traps, resulting in significant reduction of the current collapse and the dynamic ON-resistance in AlGaN/GaN HEMTs under high-drain-bias switching conditions.
